## #1 — tg_jp — 2012-01-17
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/8024/post-66626>

Edge N Splitter.js

hello

It's a tool script to split edge with input number.
Place it into ~/Library/Application Support/Cheetah3D/scripts/Tool folder to install.

download -> http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=80

[CAUTION] Don't use 'undo' command after execution of this Tool!! It causes crash.

[UPDATE 20120413] undo/redo are available for only Cheetah3D 6.0+

regards.

tg_jp, Hiroto.

Links: http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=80

## #13 — Rene66 — 2013-10-12
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/8024/post-82276>

Here's the solution Zoohead - I'm in California and did it this way:

Went to Hiroto's link:
http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/fil...icle.php?id=80

Clicked on download link & I got a file just as you described, named "Edge"

With the "Edge" file highlited, I hit "Return" once so I can rename it.

I add ".zip" to the end of the file and hit Return.

You will be prompted - select "Add"

Now double-click on file to unzip.

TaDa 

R.

Links: http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=80
